snippet.title: 7 Days To Think About It - Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
BIG NEWS! 📣
“7 Days To Think About It” is coming this summer, on July 16th, 2026! 🥳

Your friends want to hang out tonight: you're trapped at home, overthinking it for 7 days.

New demo with new finale available.
Play and wishlist here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3828980/7_Days_To_Think_About_It/
